policy.note: Phase 1 release gate only. apps/web and apps/mobile are non-production shells; their advisories appear in the full audit report and are remediated before those surfaces are promoted. Green CI does not imply production security (SECURITY.md section 7).

exceptions.reason: The patched Zod 4 major release requires a validation-layer migration across API request schemas; a rushed bump would change runtime validation behaviour in the Phase 1 release.
exceptions.remediationPlan: Migrate the API validation layer to Zod 4 (or an approved patched 3.x release), rerun typechecks, shared tests and the full API smoke suite, then remove this exception in the same PR.
